chars.NARRATOR: a Moroccan young man of 25 with short black curly hair and a light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan young man of 25 with a buzz cut and a thin moustache, wearing a red-and-white striped football jersey and khaki cargo shorts
chars.MUSTAFA: a Moroccan young man of 26 with a thick black beard and a small man-bun, wearing a white linen shirt with the collar open and light-blue jeans
chars.GIRL: a European young woman tourist of 24 with a long blond braid and freckles, wearing a green floral summer dress
chars.FOREIGNER: a tall European young man of 26 with ginger hair and a ginger beard, wearing a black tank top and blue board shorts

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the top of a dark stairwell doorway: on a rooftop terrace of an old whitewashed riad in Essaouira at night, MUSTAFA sits very close to GIRL on floor cushions, caught mid-act leaning in with a cheeky grin while she giggles, string lights, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: FRIEND sprints up a narrow whitewashed riad staircase with blue doors in Essaouira at night, taking two steps at a time, determined frown, seen from below, head-to-waist framing, face visible, dynamic motion.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR climbs the same narrow whitewashed staircase behind, one hand on the wall, worried wide eyes and raised eyebrows, warm lamp light, medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: On the riad rooftop terrace at night with string lights, FOREIGNER stands over MUSTAFA, pointing at him furiously, while MUSTAFA sits on a cushion with both palms raised in innocent surprise, medium-wide shot, both faces visible, comic tension.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: On the rooftop terrace at night, NARRATOR grabs FRIEND from behind by both arms to hold him back, FRIEND leans forward angrily, NARRATOR looks panicked, medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the rooftop terrace at night, GIRL stands shouting dramatically with both arms raised in the air, mouth wide open, outraged, string lights behind, head-to-waist framing, face visible, comic theatrical anger.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: On the rooftop terrace at night, NARRATOR covers his mouth with his hand trying hard not to burst out laughing, eyes squeezed with tears of laughter, shoulders shaking, medium close-up, face visible.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: On the rooftop terrace at night, FOREIGNER hops on one foot while pulling on a sandal, pointing his finger angrily toward the stairs as if threatening to go to the police, red angry face, medium shot, face visible, comic.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: On the rooftop terrace at night, FOREIGNER leans in and accuses MUSTAFA face to face, jabbing a finger at his chest; MUSTAFA leans back with an awkward guilty smile, scratching his head, medium shot, both faces visible.
